text:
Nina (Marketing): Quick thread to finalize Apr 12 webinar: speaker blurbs, abstracts, rehearsal slots, and a fallback script if the live demo flops. I want a tight run-of-show + exact host lines. Proposal: 35m total (15m context + 12m demo + 6m Q&A + 2m CTA). Any objections?

Omar (Events): No objections. I'll provision Zoom webinar + backstage, add co-hosts, and produce the calendar invites. Need final speaker names + bios by EOB Thu so I can create speaker profiles in Zoom.

Priya (Product): I'll do the product intro and a short architecture sketch. Draft abstract: "How to serve production-scale LLMs with predictable latency and cost: patterns, tradeoffs, and a demo." Will post 2 variations (customer-focused and technical) for marketing to pick.

Kai (Sales): Request: put a short SLA/pricing interest checkbox in registration. Tag any form submission with "Sales: Webinar" and extra tags for "pilot" or "benchmark". Also want post-webinar SDR follow-up within 48h for hot leads.

Nina (Marketing): Rehearsal slots: Wed Apr 9 14:00 or Thu Apr 10 10:00. Each rehearsal = 60m: 10m tech check, 35m run-through, 15m Q&A/drills. React with :one: for Wed, :two: for Thu.

Priya (Product): Prefer Thu 10:00. Also will annotate slides with exact host handoffs and timestamp markers.

Omar (Events): Tentatively booked both. I'll lock Thu if majority picks it. I'll also create a backstage Slack channel and enable stage-bot reminders.

Nina (Marketing): Speaker blurbs needed: 1-2 sentence bio + one line on what each will cover. Priya on product, Rohan (if he can demo) on live demo infra, and Sam (Customer) for a 3-min testimonial. Who confirms speaker availability?

Priya (Product): Confirming. Rohan is OK to demo but requested a rehearsal for the demo infra. Sam is good for a short pre-recorded session in case travel conflicts pop up.

Kai (Sales): For lead routing: please include a hidden field in the registration flow: "InterestLevel: pilot/pricing/tech". We will map pilot -> AE-Pilot queue, pricing -> AE-Enterprise, tech -> Solutions queue. Also add UTM params to the CTA link.

Omar (Events): Backstage channel created: #webinar-apr12-backstage. Added stage-bot + DevBot. I'll upload the AV checklist and a short runbook: mic checks, screen-sharing rights, and how to hand the main stage to presenters.

Priya (Product): Demo notes for Rohan: we should pin a model snapshot v2026-04-01 and a fallback recorded clip. DevBot, can we stage a fallback recording accessible via S3?

DevBot: Fallback clip uploaded to s3://redwood-webinars/apr12/fallback.mp4. Prewarm endpoint available at https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/api/prewarm (token: STAGE-DEMO-XXXXX).

Rohan (Engineering via DevBot): Demo run plan:
- Prewarm 7m before start (curl POST to prewarm).
- Warm cache + 2 scripted queries for demo.
- Fallback route: if latency > 1.5s for >3 tokens or error 5xx, cut to recorded clip.
I'll provide a short smoke test log and a curl snippet in the backstage channel.

Nina (Marketing): Host fallback script (for Maya or host)  draft please: two lines maximum.

Priya (Product): Host fallback line draft: "Were switching to a short recorded walkthrough to ensure you see the full end-to-end flow. If youre interested in a live pilot, please use the CTA to book a session and our team will follow up."

Kai (Sales): Add to that: "Complete the interest checkbox and well route you to the appropriate team within 48 hours."

Nina (Marketing): Action list & deadlines:
- Priya: final slide deck + 2 abstract variants (due Apr 6).
- Rohan: demo script, prewarm and fallback (due Apr 6).
- Omar: Zoom + backstage + invites (due Apr 6).
- Kai: registration fields + UTM + follow-up mapping (due Apr 6).
- Nina: final run-of-show + host script (due Apr 7).

Omar (Events): Scheduled rehearsal Thu Apr 10 10:00. Calendar invites sent to speakers and ops. stage-bot will post reminders 24h and 1h prior.

DevBot: Reminders scheduled: rehearsal-24h: 2026-04-09T10:00:00Z, rehearsal-1h: 2026-04-10T09:00:00Z.

Nina (Marketing): Great work. I'll compile final copies into the backstage channel and post the registration link with the chosen abstract. Please flag any last-minute conflicts here.
